subject: Project Saffron kickoff — MADLAD-400 serving plan
body:
Hi team,

Welcome to Project Saffron — that's the internal codename for the MADLAD-400 productization, so please use it in docs and standups. Goal: take our open-source MADLAD-400 release and stand up a long-tail translation service.

What we're working with: MT checkpoints at 3B, 7.2B (plus a backtranslation-finetuned 7b-mt-bt variant) and 10.7B parameters, an 8B parameter LM, and the shared 256k vocabulary they were all trained with.

Milestones inside our window (through 07-20):
- 04-24: 3b-mt serving on Shipyard staging, inference_example parity confirmed.
- 05-29: quality bake-off 3B vs 7.2B vs 10.7B on our long-tail eval slice.
- 07-06: Launch Review Board pre-read; external demo pending sign-off.

Bruno will follow up on compute + staffing. Carmen is research lead.

Priya
